units.source_text: 一进后门，眼前就看见这家人横七竖八地躺着。

en.t: As soon as he entered by the back door, he saw the whole family lying sprawled every which way.

units.source_text: 他们盖着硬梆梆的褪了色的棉被，就如同这一带人常穿的雪裤的棉花一样。

en.t: They were covered with stiff, faded cotton quilts, like the wadding in the snow trousers people around here often wore.

units.source_text: 这家夫妻和十七八岁的大姑娘，还有五六个孩子，在昏暗的灯光下，各朝各的方向去睡。

en.t: The husband and wife, their seventeen- or eighteen-year-old grown daughter, and five or six children slept under the dim light, each facing a different direction.

units.source_text: 这幅图景，使人感到在清贫孤寂的家中，也充满一种刚劲的力量。

en.t: The scene made one feel that even in this poor and lonely household there was a kind of tough, vigorous strength.
